about_the_game:
This is a demo version released for the October 2025 edition of Steam Next Fest. The full game will be released reflecting the feedback from this demo.

Demo Features

  • This demo offers the same languages and accessibility features as the full game.

  • It includes the following content from the full game:

    • Progress the story by identifying anomalies.

    • Open locked doors and enter secret areas.

  • Achievements are not available.

Repeating corridors, subtly distorted spaces. Can you escape this endless loop?

"Phil in the Mirror" is a first‑person psychological adventure game in the Metroidbrainia genre that combines light tension with simple observation‑based puzzles. Instead of complex controls or intense action, it focuses on unraveling mysteries through careful observation and deduction. The hints for the puzzles are always right before your eyes.

Observe, deduce, and proceed.

You begin on the 9th floor. Every hallway you traverse looks identical—but it might not be. Scrutinize your surroundings to uncover any “anomalies.”

  • If you discover an anomaly, immediately retrace your steps and return to the elevator you boarded.

  • If there is no anomaly, take the elevator at the end of the hallway to proceed to the next floor.

  • If you disobey these instructions, you will not be allowed to descend to the next floor.

This simple rule will put you to the test. Your powers of observation are literally your only means of survival.

Unlock sealed doors and enter hidden chambers.

As Phil, you must explore various spaces and draw closer to the building’s secrets.

Gather countless clues to complete a single story. Then face the truth.

In this enigmatic realm, will you confront the truth and find the true exit?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware raytracing feature required, SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (8GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware raytracing feature required, SSD recommended

short_description: The mirror calls to you. Down the endless corridor, aged walls and flickering lights cross paths. As your footsteps echo with every step, why do you find yourself frozen before the mirror? Then again, maybe it's not a mirror at all.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Korean
